resources.gpu_timing_synchronised: not applicable, no GPU timing is reported
resources.peak_memory_convention: process RSS peak via tracemalloc is not available for native tensors; no peak tensor memory is claimed. RSS is NOT the native tensor allocation peak.

conditions.gamma_rule: alpha * lambda_max(J_theta^T J_theta), computed once per centre
conditions.warmup: one discarded run per (centre, alpha, method)
conditions.reference: dense Cholesky solve at the same gamma

large_scale_note: The optional widened-centre operator timing was not run. Nothing in this file claims training feasibility or curvature accuracy at large state size.
claim_boundary: Cost comparison only, at matched damping. A larger alpha is a different geometry and is not selected on accuracy grounds.
